title: Idempotency check swallows store errors on Peer/deliver
description: If find_by_sender_msg_id returns Err (e.g. transient SQLite BUSY), the if let Ok(Some(...)) at kith-peer/src/lib.rs:227 silently drops the error and falls through to a fresh insert. The sender receives accepted=true with a different id for what it believes is a retry, and the receiver stores two copies of the same message.
